newsitem.title: USA: Mobile Telecom amends credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Mobile Telecom amends credit facility.

text.p: Mobile Telecommunication Technologies Corp said Thursday it has reached agreement in principle with its bank group on the terms of an amendment to its existing $250 million revolving credit facility.

The amendment will give the company liquidity and financial flexibility to execute its three-year business plan. It also contains revisions that align certain covenants to the company's current business plan, Mtel said.
The amendment is subject to completion of definitive documentation which should be finalized by March 31, 1997.
Mtel is a wireless messaging and paging company.
